sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: general driving: school bus exceptions, parking, lane changes, highway entry and exit, passing and the zipper merge
Knowledge facts: part C holds 40 fact blocks (sec10-F01 onward) from physical pages 84 to 92; part C2 holds 17 confusable and continuation blocks (sec10-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised 06/2024 cover edition, the required vision, knowledge and skills tests and the knowledge test content from physical pages 1 and 15 to 17; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- SC-PRK-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRK-A-PASS — knowledge-test passing score not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRK-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRK-A-FRESH — possibly newer unlinked manual upload not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-PRK-D-BUSRESUME — when to move on after a school bus stop is worded differently on pages 82 and 84 (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- SC-PRK-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- SC-PRK-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: none in the selected pages; the section holds school bus, parking, lane change, passing and merge rules only.

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
